rationale: The material prompt requirement is translation-data-only workspace audit without application repository wiring. At # Localize an app with Multilocale, the source is scoped to End-to-end recipe for translating a whole application with Multilocale — choose the ecosystem's own i18n runtime, create a project with explicit locales, import an existing catalogue once, download the generated files, and wire them in. Covers both a greenfield app with no i18n and an app already ru; it provides a meaningful neighbouring route but does not establish translation-data-only workspace audit without application repository wiring as required by the prompt.
